freezerRecommendations.item: Harris Teeter chicken breast value packs
freezerRecommendations.reason: Lean, flexible protein for bowls, sheet-pan dinners, and salads; freeze flat in 2-lb family dinner packs.

freezerRecommendations.item: Aldi family pack thin-sliced pork chops
freezerRecommendations.reason: Fast-cooking whole-food protein at a strong price; portion into 1.75-2 lb packs for 25-minute dinners.
Good weeknight backup if ingredients are clean enough for your preference; trim sauce portions and pair with vegetables/grains.

meals.name: HT Chicken Breast Greek Quinoa Bowls
meals.macroFit: Lean 5 oz chicken portions with high-fiber carbs and a yogurt-lemon sauce.
instructions: Cook quinoa and rinse/drain chickpeas.
Slice chicken thin, season with garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and lemon.
Sear chicken 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Mix Greek yogurt with lemon juice, dill or oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Build bowls with quinoa, chickpeas, chopped vegetables, chicken, and yogurt sauce.

meals.name: Aldi Thin-Cut Pork Chop Apple Slaw Plates
meals.protein: Fresh Family Pack Thin-Sliced Pork Chops
meals.macroFit: Thin chops cook quickly; slaw and sweet potatoes keep the plate clean and filling.
instructions: Microwave cubed sweet potatoes 5 to 6 minutes, then crisp in an air fryer or skillet.
Toss slaw mix with thin-sliced apples, cider vinegar, Dijon, salt, pepper, and a little olive oil.
Steam or sauté green beans until tender-crisp.
Season pork chops with garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper; sear 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Serve pork with sweet potatoes, green beans, and apple slaw.

meals.name: HT Shrimp Brown Rice Taco Bowls
meals.macroFit: Very lean seafood with beans and brown rice for fiber-rich complex carbs.
instructions: Cook brown rice and warm drained black beans.
Toss cabbage with lime juice, salt, and diced avocado.
Sauté sliced bell peppers until tender-crisp.
Cook shrimp with taco seasoning, garlic, and lime for 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Serve shrimp over rice and beans with peppers and slaw.

meals.name: BOGO Pork Tenderloin Farro Skillet
meals.protein: Smithfield Marinated Pork Loin Filets & Tenderloins
meals.macroFit: Use sauce-light slices with a big vegetable skillet and chewy whole-grain farro.
instructions: Cook quick farro according to package directions.
Slice pork into medallions so it cooks fast.
Sear pork medallions 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through; rest briefly.
Sauté zucchini and mushrooms, then wilt in spinach with lemon juice.
Serve pork over farro with the vegetable skillet.

meals.name: Aldi Petite Beef Tender Fajita Bowls
meals.protein: Morton's of Omaha Petite Beef Tender
meals.macroFit: Portion steak at 4 oz/person and lean on beans/rice for a balanced family bowl.
instructions: Cook rice and warm drained black beans.
Season beef with fajita seasoning and lime juice.
Sear beef 3 to 4 minutes per side depending on thickness; rest before slicing.
Sauté peppers and onions in the same skillet.
Build bowls with rice, beans, romaine, vegetables, sliced beef, and lime.

meals.name: Chicken Sausage Sweet Potato Sheet Pan
meals.macroFit: The convenience pick: keep sausage portions moderate and load the tray with vegetables.
instructions: Dice sweet potatoes small and microwave 4 minutes to jump-start cooking.
Slice sausage, broccoli, Brussels sprouts, and onion.
Toss everything with olive oil, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Roast or air-fry at 425°F for 18 to 22 minutes, stirring once.
Serve as sheet-pan plates with extra greens if desired.
